cases.name: ebox-stretched-row-preserves-cell-paint-through-updates
cases.purpose: Grid and nested Flex rows preserve clipped cell widths and background coverage after content, assigned or automatic height, and viewport updates.

cases.name: ebox-grid-fixed-row-preserves-tracks-and-paint-through-updates
cases.purpose: Fixed Grid rows preserve clipping, cell paint and box sizing after padding, track and cell-width changes, including native publication when available and fallback when sizing changes.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-width-keeps-frame-reference-through-updates
cases.purpose: Root and nested vw widths preserve the frame reference through parent, viewport, fractional-geometry fallback and content updates.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-width-constrains-flex-minima-maxima-and-basis
cases.purpose: Flex item vw minima, maxima and bases track the frame viewport rather than their containing allocation.

cases.name: ebox-scoped-content-updates-retain-native-interaction
cases.purpose: Local content retains scoped paint and native callbacks; replacement and failed keymap updates preserve accepted behavior.

cases.name: ebox-selector-candidates-preserve-relations-and-rollback
cases.purpose: Repeated subtree changes preserve structural styles, rollback and exported snapshots.

cases.name: ebox-scoped-candidates-combine-content-and-selector-paint
cases.purpose: Publish adjacent text and class-dependent paint with fresh-render equivalence; diagnostic reports remain defensive and preserve the last successful update after rejection.

cases.name: ebox-inherited-paint-keeps-subsequent-content-and-snapshots
cases.purpose: Repeated inherited parent paint and child content updates retain matching output, styles and independently renderable canonical snapshots.

cases.name: ebox-native-input-restores-focus-through-reorder-and-errors
cases.purpose: Native input preserves results and restores the retained target after errors.

cases.name: ebox-native-input-invalidates-disposed-or-disabled-targets
cases.purpose: A completed reader cannot authorize input after its target loses ownership.

cases.name: ebox-native-input-rejects-invalid-entry-and-unaccepted-transactions
cases.purpose: Readers cannot run for missing targets or within an unaccepted Ebox transaction.

cases.name: ebox-overlapping-replacements-retain-parent-text-and-child-state
cases.purpose: Same-length text changes survive a subsequent retained child replacement.

cases.name: ebox-nested-range-updates-preserve-later-host-replacements
cases.purpose: Nested Range updates preserve visible content and subsequent Host replacement.

cases.name: ebox-large-candidate-removal-preserves-source-order-and-rollback
cases.purpose: Large keyed list removals and insertions match fresh rendering and reject atomically.

cases.name: ebox-overlapping-ranges-preserve-followup-child-updates
cases.purpose: Nested Range writes refine ancestor content in either recording order and preserve later Host updates.

cases.name: ebox-keyed-range-child-moves-before-a-nested-host-update
cases.purpose: A keyed field retains focus and remains updatable after sibling insertion or removal, with atomic rejection.

cases.name: ebox-explicit-host-identity-survives-sibling-changes-without-keys
cases.purpose: An unkeyed Host with stable source identity retains focus and nested updates across conditional sibling changes.

cases.name: ebox-grid-fractional-row-fills-tracks-through-resize-and-updates
cases.purpose: Fractional cells retain their allocation, paint and content when resized.

cases.name: ebox-grid-text-row-preserves-intrinsic-minima
cases.purpose: Text tracks keep unbreakable minima in definite and intrinsic layouts.

cases.name: ebox-shared-scopes-reorder-keeps-current-colors
cases.purpose: Reordering retained nodes preserves current slot and fallback colors.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-height-keeps-frame-reference-through-updates
cases.purpose: Nested viewport heights and arithmetic follow frame resize and retained updates.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-height-constrains-flex-minima-maxima-and-basis
cases.purpose: Column Flex constraints retain their original viewport reference.

cases.name: ebox-scroll-containers-compose-through-layout-and-updates
cases.purpose: Nested and sibling scrolling containers compose in Column and Flex and retain independent visible content through updates and resize.

cases.name: ebox-shared-scopes-insertion-keeps-current-inheritance-and-membership
cases.purpose: Sibling insertion preserves scoped paint while later rule, membership and ancestry changes update the visible result.

cases.name: ebox-drag-follows-keyed-owner-and-publishes-release
cases.purpose: Movement and release retain the keyed target across visible reordering.

cases.name: ebox-drag-cancels-disabled-target-and-preserves-unrelated-input
cases.purpose: Disabling the target ends tracking; unrelated input returns to Emacs.

cases.name: ebox-drag-cancels-when-leaving-the-original-window
cases.purpose: Leaving the original text window cancels the gesture.

cases.name: ebox-drag-releases-removed-owners-and-lost-windows
cases.purpose: Removed targets, unmount and switched windows release active tracking.

cases.name: ebox-nested-flex-keeps-current-content-and-viewport
cases.purpose: Nested Flex keeps current wrapping, sibling placement and output width through content updates and viewport changes.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-uses-replaced-mouse-binding
cases.purpose: A held retained target activates its newly accepted explicit mouse callback instead of a stale callback or keyboard binding.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-keeps-pure-text-activation
cases.purpose: Generated maps remain usable on pure rendered text without mounting a retained surface.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-clears-active-when-target-is-clipped
cases.purpose: Clipping a held target clears its selector state in the same visible publication and cancels activation.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-compose-layout-interaction-and-content
cases.purpose: Layout and native interaction changes preserve child content updates, editable handles and snapshot parity.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-compose-with-range-reorder
cases.purpose: Parent property changes compose with Range reordering in either order while retaining focus and editable child handles.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-inherit-into-replaced-styled-subtrees
cases.purpose: An inherited property update on a parent composes with same-candidate Range items that own styled Box children, reaching every new leaf.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-preserve-text-and-structural-ownership
cases.purpose: Property updates preserve text, refine retained structural replacements and do not resurrect removed owners.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-update-selector-facts-and-rules
cases.purpose: Class changes and rule replacement/removal restyle retained descendants through the shared cascade.

cases.name: ebox-range-reorders-preserve-nested-updates-and-focus
cases.purpose: Keyed and unkeyed source identities preserve focus, published content and subsequent nested Range updates through reorder, insertion and removal.

cases.name: ebox-focus-within-navigates-retained-subtrees
cases.purpose: Scoped focus navigates eligible controls, wraps within a panel and follows keyed reorder without changing global focus authority.

cases.name: ebox-focus-within-rejects-unavailable-and-unaccepted-targets
cases.purpose: Invalid, hidden, unmounted and provisional focus roots reject movement while preserving accepted focus and point.

cases.name: ebox-focus-retains-local-facts-and-structural-inheritance
cases.purpose: Repeated focus transitions and intervening content updates preserve current selector facts, inherited local paint and structural sibling/descendant rules.

cases.name: ebox-responsive-cache-keeps-current-containing-size
cases.purpose: Percentage-sized paint follows containing width and height across repeated resizes and unrelated content publications without stale cache reuse.

cases.name: ebox-responsive-cache-preserves-cyclic-native-keymaps
cases.purpose: Responsive subtrees mount with a recursive native keymap, retain activation across unrelated updates and use a newly published replacement binding.

cases.name: ebox-flex-progress-updates-preserve-fractional-sibling-geometry
cases.purpose: Repeated simultaneous progress width and label updates retain sibling pixel geometry and enclosing paint, matching a fresh render after parent size and color changes.

cases.name: ebox-focus-state-only-observation-keeps-independent-inputs
cases.purpose: Repeated state-only focus updates retain independent mounts and pure input while public exclusive phase timings account for the whole observed commit.

cases.name: ebox-layer-source-intervals-preserve-unicode-and-properties
cases.purpose: Layer show/hide updates preserve untouched CJK and combining glyphs, native properties and caller inputs.

cases.name: ebox-layer-flow-z-order-can-cross-overlay
cases.purpose: Changing normal-flow z order across a positioned overlay preserves the correct visible winner through repeated commits.

cases.name: ebox-flex-rich-local-updates-preserve-paint-and-targets
cases.purpose: Local rich-text and progress changes preserve fresh-render paint, live target bounds, cyclic native keymaps and callbacks through later enclosing paint updates.

cases.name: ebox-row-disjoint-rich-updates-preserve-line-dependencies
cases.purpose: Two rich-text updates on shared physical lines retain sibling paint and both target bounds across changed newline placement and later parent paint.

cases.name: ebox-publication-rejects-participant-text-corruption
cases.purpose: Framework text-property writes outside the prepared result reject publication and restore text, revision and retained addresses.

cases.name: ebox-publication-rollback-restores-unaffected-output
cases.purpose: A framework stage that mutates text and properties outside the prepared change rejects atomically and restores the complete surface, revision and retained handles.

cases.name: ebox-display-native-decline-reports-missing-viewport
cases.purpose: An unbounded hidden mount renders correctly and reports why native geometry is unavailable; a later viewport update does not retain the stale diagnostic.

cases.name: ebox-region-geometry-updates-position-size-and-layer-atomically
cases.purpose: One typed Box geometry update changes position, size and stacking facts through retained publication and matches a fresh render; the geometry query is defensive.

cases.name: ebox-region-update-geometry-rejects-non-geometry-and-text
cases.purpose: The low-level geometry boundary rejects content, paint, malformed and Text updates before publication.

cases.name: ebox-interaction-hover-content-follows-retained-geometry
cases.purpose: Hover content responds at a target's committed position after a retained geometry update, without any intervening input.

cases.name: ebox-interaction-hover-content-uses-retained-updates
cases.purpose: A node-declared hover content value enters and leaves through retained Ebox content updates with local motion tracking and no overlay.

cases.name: ebox-drag-coalesces-bounded-bursts-and-keeps-release-position
cases.purpose: Pending motion bursts publish bounded latest positions and preserve the exact release endpoint through the public native keymap.

cases.name: ebox-drag-preserves-input-barriers-and-remaining-event-order
cases.purpose: Keys and another primary press stop motion merging while preserving the complete remaining native input order.

cases.name: ebox-drag-treats-another-window-as-a-motion-barrier
cases.purpose: Motion crossing another window cancels at the last accepted position without consuming later original-window input.

cases.name: ebox-drag-rechecks-target-after-wait-and-motion-poll
cases.purpose: A target disabled, removed or unmounted while native reads run is cancelled before motion dispatch and unrelated input is retained.

cases.name: ebox-drag-locked-end-rejects-finishing-motion-and-release-position
cases.purpose: A locked gesture ends once at its second press and cannot publish later motion or replace that endpoint with its final release.

cases.name: ebox-drag-locked-escape-preserves-later-input
cases.purpose: Escape cancels a locked motion burst and leaves later native input in its original order.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-retains-source-and-snapshots
cases.purpose: Prepared translations and stacking preserve prior exported source snapshots and feed the latest geometry into the next ordinary publication.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-rejects-and-recovers-paired-state
cases.purpose: A failed prepared publication restores source facts, pixels, revision and caller state, then accepts a valid retry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-composes-nested-fixed-canvas
cases.purpose: Prepared moves inside a bordered nested canvas retain enclosing rows, paint and native properties with fresh-render parity.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-reveals-occluded-host-and-wrapper-bounds
cases.purpose: Prepared translation and stacking reveal occluded Hosts with fresh-mount interaction properties and margin-free bounds, including fixed wrapper borders and padding.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-retries-disjoint-multi-row-moves
cases.purpose: Repeated multi-row translation across separated row ranges preserves source, pixels, properties, bounds and paired state after rejection and matches fresh mounts after each retry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-reprepares-after-ordinary-paint
cases.purpose: Repreparing after an ordinary paint publication leaves the previous operation stale and preserves accepted pixels, bounds, report, revision and mount identity through a rejected move before a successful retry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-skips-rows-with-unchanged-pixels
cases.purpose: Restacking a positioned panel that occludes nothing publishes zero text, property and touched-character operations while the accepted output, revision and Host bounds stay authoritative; overlapping restacks still repaint.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-binds-paint-slot-after-spec-update
cases.purpose: A prepared :color cell bound to a paint slot stays preparable after the slot's face specification changes, matching the slot by its stable face rather than its copied specification.

cases.name: ebox-paint-slot-copies-share-face-state
cases.purpose: Copies of a paint slot compare equal and report the slot's current specification and installation state through updates and rollback.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-reprepares-after-inserting-host
cases.purpose: Inserting a Host invalidates the previous prepared operation without mutation; fresh preparation includes the added Host in occlusion, visible bounds and fresh-render parity.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-retains-source-through-focus-reentry
cases.purpose: Focus and unchanged-axis context generations remain source-resolvable across prepared moves, later focus changes and unrelated ordinary content and native-property updates.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-rebuilds-inherited-paint-on-ordinary-update
cases.purpose: Prepared inherited paint survives rejected ordinary publication, unrelated later content and native-property updates, unchanged viewport refresh and detached snapshot reuse.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-rejects-unrecorded-buffer-hook-rewrite
cases.purpose: External buffer-hook text rewrites reject a prepared frame and restore source geometry, visible properties, Host bounds, revision and point before a later valid move.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-rejects-stage-output-mutation
cases.purpose: Unrecorded stage property writes restore paired state, source, pixels and the last accepted report, including rejection after an earlier prepared success.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-snapshots-caller-values-before-hooks
cases.purpose: A buffer hook mutating the caller-owned reusable geometry vector cannot change the source values already used to render the prepared frame.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-respects-important-cascade
cases.purpose: Equal current inline and important stylesheet positions do not authorize a prepared move to bypass cascade precedence; ordinary fallback preserves effective geometry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-crosses-flow-stacking-and-visible-clip
cases.purpose: Prepared movement and stacking across normal flow and each clipping edge preserve source rendering, pixels and native interaction properties.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-follows-focus-unless-point-moved-manually
cases.purpose: Prepared translation makes logical focus follow its visible target, preserves independently moved point, and resumes following when point returns to the target.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-clears-occluded-focus-after-acceptance
cases.purpose: Rejected occlusion preserves focus, point and source selectors; accepted complete occlusion clears logical focus and the focused selector state.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-delivers-paired-defensive-observations
cases.purpose: Accepted prepared updates deliver correlated publication and Ebox reports with defensive values and phase timing; rejected frames do not notify observers.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-switches-target-with-current-pixels
cases.purpose: Preparing another geometry target after an accepted move preserves current pixels and source geometry rather than reusing an earlier canvas ledger.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-declines-root-without-containing-plane
cases.purpose: A standalone absolute root has no containing-plane program and declines without error; its ordinary typed geometry update remains usable.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-rejects-changed-text-scale
cases.purpose: Changing buffer-local text scale rejects prepared geometry and stale repreparation without callbacks or publication changes; ordinary display refresh enables a correct new operation.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-geometry-rejects-changed-face-remapping
cases.purpose: Updating an existing default-face remapping rejects its prepared geometry without changing source, output, bounds or revision; ordinary refresh permits valid preparation.

cases.name: ebox-drag-prepared-geometry-retains-and-releases-active-owner
cases.purpose: Prepared geometry keeps the pressed target through row movement, then accepted occlusion clears active selector facts and terminates the native gesture.

cases.name: ebox-interaction-prepared-geometry-updates-hover-bounds
cases.purpose: Prepared movement and rollback preserve hover content behavior at moved and newly revealed control positions.

cases.name: ebox-interaction-prepared-occlusion-declines-changing-focus-style
cases.purpose: Focused translation remains prepared while an occluding update requiring different focus paint declines without changing source, pixels, point or revision.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-publishes-mixed-members-once
cases.purpose: Mixed geometry, inherited paint, hover content and Text publish once; later sparse geometry retains the accepted native hover capability.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-rolls-back-all-members-and-retries
cases.purpose: A failing stage reverses multiple caller cells and all source/display changes; retry succeeds and unsupported text footprint changes preserve the accepted generation.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-recovers-after-abandoned-preparation
cases.purpose: A preparation abandoned by a non-local exit reports interruption, leaves output and revision unchanged, invalidates earlier operations and the next preparation publishes correctly.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-toggles-visibility-over-deep-subtree
cases.purpose: Hiding, showing and recoloring a positioned Host with a deep subtree through the prepared route matches a fresh render: visibility stays a paint boundary of the Host while inherited color and font-weight changes still reach descendants that inherit them.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-translates-without-repainting-repeated-paint
cases.purpose: A mixed cohort whose paint and Text values repeat their displayed values only translates retained primitives and reports geometry work, while a changed color or Text still repaints or re-renders its boundary, matching a fresh render each time.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-hides-and-shows-positioned-panel
cases.purpose: A prepared visibility member hides a positioned panel's footprint and restores it with its geometry through the retained route, matching a fresh render.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-shows-initially-hidden-positioned-panel
cases.purpose: A panel mounted hidden remains a prepared member: moves while hidden paint nothing and a visibility change paints it at its current placement, matching a fresh render.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-fits-variable-text-in-fixed-flex-allocation
cases.purpose: A fixed Flex status allocation accepts variable-length titles, clips long content before adjacent controls, and restores prior content and revision on rejection.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-fits-variable-text-in-clipped-or-full-slot
cases.purpose: Initially clipped or exactly full fixed Text slots accept shorter and longer content through the prepared route, matching a fresh render each time.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-update-declines-initially-empty-slot-atomically
cases.purpose: An initially empty fixed Text slot declines text growth without callbacks, source mutation, visible edits or revision advancement.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-native-state-retains-rollback-banks
cases.purpose: Interleaved geometry and native active/focus/clear publications preserve independent mount/report banks and restore bounds, pixels, point, selectors and revision after rejected geometry before retry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-publication-focus-selector-keeps-ordinary-paint
cases.purpose: A focus-dependent stylesheet retains the ordinary style publication path and correct focused rendering.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-focus-publishes-all-visible-channels-once
cases.purpose: Window raise, taskbar active classes, unchanged-thickness border colors, measured font weights and variable status publish once through a stable prepared cohort with immediate selector queries and fresh-render equivalence.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-focus-rebinds-after-resize-and-style-updates
cases.purpose: Resized geometry and changed inherited paint invalidate old focus operations; new preparation preserves pixels and revision, and sparse geometry followed by coordinated focus remains equivalent to fresh rendering.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-focus-rejection-restores-selector-font-and-caller
cases.purpose: A rejected focus cohort restores selector classes, border and font paint, source, display, revision and multiple caller cells; retry publishes the complete focus state.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-selector-publishes-class-border-and-rollback
cases.purpose: Finite class variants and fixed border colors publish together with immediate selector queries, exact rollback, detached snapshot isolation, empty classes and rejection of unknown classes or changed border geometry.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-selector-rejects-combined-relational-effects
cases.purpose: Class preparation rejects changes that can jointly activate an ancestor :has rule across two Hosts, preserving source selectors, pixels and revision.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-selector-rollback-restores-restyled-flex-items
cases.purpose: A rejected class change whose restyle deletes or re-adds flex item properties restores each node's exact plist, so pixels, revision, later accepted variants and a structural commit stay correct.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-selector-preserves-source-token-grammar
cases.purpose: Prepared class variants preserve the canonical source grammar for single strings, symbols, nil and flat token lists, including one token containing whitespace and snapshot isolation.

cases.name: ebox-prepared-selector-reprepares-after-ordinary-commit
cases.purpose: An ordinary commit after prepared class writes invalidates the old cohort, renders like a fresh mount, and lets a new class cohort bind, publish and answer selector queries.
